plan: Final experiment design delivered as a single self-contained document. Sections: (1) Rationale stating the matched-capacity / matched-eval / uncertainty requirements and why they are necessary. (2) Conditions — primary arms Llama-2-7b-hf vs FuseLLM-7B at matched 7B, optional secondary arms (chat variant, 13B pair, source-LLM diagnostic) clearly marked. (3) CS benchmark composition (BoolQ, PIQA, HellaSwag, WinoGrande, ARC-E, ARC-C, OBQA; macro-mean aggregate). (4) Zero-shot evaluation protocol covering harness pinning, ranking-based greedy LLR decoding (no sampling), bf16 precision, num_fewshot=0, max_seq_length=2048, batch_size=auto, stock template-only prompts, paired sha256-keyed JSONL construction with --include_path, and the 100-item length/token sanity sweep. (5) Aggregate metric defined as unweighted macro-mean of the 7 per-task accuracies with explicit metric column (acc for boolq/winogrande; acc_norm for the rest). (6) Statistical analysis: per-task Wilson 95% CIs, 10k item-level bootstrap 95% CI on Δ with seed 42 (paired within-task), one-sided exact binomial sign test over n=7 reported as descriptive (table of p-values by n_tasks_B_ge_A included, with the alpha=0.05 cut noted as unreachable), and a paired item-level sign test as the powered inferential check. (7) Controls table with 11 enumerated controls (identical prompts, identical scoring, native tokenizers, identical decoder/precision/length/batch, length sweep, paired denominators, no MC correction, no runtime mixture, seed pinning, harness pinning, no silent baseline switch). (8) Pre-registered seeds and verbatim harness flags. (9) Compute envelope — sandbox infeasibility stated (CPU/no-network/no-ML-stack), external minimum specified as 1× A100-80GB bf16 bs=1 with expected ~40–60 min/arm wall-clock. (10) Reproducibility checklist. (11) Seven caveats enumerated (prompt sensitivity, contamination, harness drift, task non-independence, n=7 power limit with exact p reported, no MC correction, sandbox infeasibility). (12) Source-art pointer to /workspace/task.json including its 'Design-only task; repositories and compute are not required' clause. (13) Design contract — an ordered 12-step list of what would be executed if/when run elsewhere. Document explicitly notes that no execution was performed and no empirical outcomes are fabricated.
